description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetQueueAdapter in the Orleans streaming framework, verifying its behavior against different relational databases like SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. It includes setup, construction, enqueueing, and receiver operation tests.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetQueueAdapterTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapter against SQL Server.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetQueueAdapterTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapter against MySQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetQueueAdapterTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapter against PostgreSQL.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterTests
classes.description: Abstract test class for AdoNetQueueAdapter, parameterized by database invariant, includes tests for construction, enqueueing, and receiving messages.

classes.name: TestModel
classes.description: A serializable record type used in test message payloads.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the relational storage and queries for testing.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapter_Constructs
methods.description: Verifies that the adapter constructs with the correct initial state.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapter_EnqueuesMessages
methods.description: Tests queuing multiple messages into the database and verifies persistence.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapter_WiresUpReceiver
methods.description: Tests setting up a receiver, dequeuing messages, and verifying their state.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes resources after tests, currently a no-op.
